blurb: For over 70 years, Port Angeles Community Players (PACP) have brought creative opportunities and entertainment to area residents and visitors alike. Come play with us!Since 1951, the dedicated volunteers of the PACP have presented a great variety of stage productions for the enjoyment of the community.
